Wednesday unveiled a five-year compute donation valued at $250M to strengthen the United Kingdom’s agentic safety and security research capability.
The commitment will provide $50M in compute access annually to support agentic safety and security research across the U.K.
“AI capability and safety must advance together,” said Jensen Huang, founder and CEO of Nvidia.
The compute access will be delivered through U.K.-based Nvidia cloud partners, supporting the nation’s research capability and compute ecosystem.

title: Nvidia commits $250M over 5 years to advance UK agentic safety research
